calibration_scope: Same three-station Bay training region as the 2024 cross-region experiment, fit in preceding December; no future or Front Range outcomes used for mapping.
primary_comparison: All registered opportunity mean Brier for LLM selector versus risk and complete-batch selectors, plus cheap full-update and all-read controls; every invalid/uncalled/missing opportunity retained.
grouping: Use source target identity and calendar block sensitivity; do not assume leads, nearby stations or adjacent days are independent.
release_gate: Decode or explicitly quarantine all native inputs; preserve current raw unparsed TAF with frozen fallback; verify calibration splits and tokenizer bounds before any GPU launch.
scope_limit: Temporal replication, not a proof of original first-seen, post-acquisition calibration, model training-data exclusion or all16 hazard novelty.
